text: From Reykjavik: South coast, Diamond Beach &Glacier Lagoon Day Tour guided in Chinese冰岛南岸钻石沙滩&冰河湖中文一日团 ⁠ ⁠ BOOK NOW English en 简体中文 zh Home Our Chinese Tours Our English Tours Westman Islands Transfers Our Solar Eclipse Tour Shore Excursions Our Northern Lights Tours English Partner Tours Partner Small Group Tours Bus Rental Private Tours Terms & Conditions Contact Special Offers Tour View more From Reykjavik: South coast, Diamond Beach &Glacier Lagoon Day Tour guided in Chinese冰岛南岸钻石沙滩&冰河湖中文一日团 14 hours and 30 minutes Easy Diamond Beach Glacier Lagoon Black Sand Beach Day Tour guided in Chinese Embark on an unforgettable winter adventure to two of Iceland’s most iconic and photogenic sites - the Glacier Lagoon Jökulsárlón and the dazzling Diamond Beach. Along the way, marvel at the breathtaking Seljalandsfoss as well as the Skógafoss waterfalls. Witness Seljalandsfoss beautifully illuminated at night, creating a magical glow against the winter darkness. Enjoy a cozy dinner break in the charming village of Vík, where you can relax and experience Icelandic hospitality. With limited daylight in winter, this tour is perfectly timed to let you experience both sunrise and sunset at Iceland’s most scenic spots, capturing their beauty in the soft, golden light of the Arctic day. The highlight of your journey awaits at Diamond Beach and Jökulsárlón Glacier Lagoon. As the sun sets, watch the icebergs sparkle on the black sand and drift peacefully across the lagoon - a photographer’s dream come true. Glacier boat tour is only available between1st May and 31st Oct. Travel comfortably with expert Chinese-speaking guides and highly skilled drivers, ensuring a safe and enjoyable experience as you explore Iceland’s winter wonderland. What's included? Pick-up Service Information Pick-up service starts at 7:00 AM. Please arrive at your selected pick-up point on time and wait for the vehicle. Please note: Bus Stop #12 is the free meeting point. Pick-up and drop-off from all other locations are available for an additional fee. Pick-up times may be slightly delayed due to traffic. The maximum waiting time is 40 minutes, so please remain at your designated pick-up point. Please look for a vehicle with the "Magic Iceland Travel" logo. Cancellation Policy You will receive a full refund if you cancel by emailing info@magicicelandtravel.com at least 24 hours before departure. Cancellations made less than 24 hours before departure are non-refundable. If the tour is cancelled by the operator due to severe weather, road conditions, or other unforeseen circumstances, we will do our best to reschedule your tour, arrange an alternative activity, or provide a full refund. The tour duration is an estimate and may vary depending on weather conditions. As our Chinese-language tours include both an English-speaking driver and a Chinese-speaking guide, they require a minimum of 10 participants to operate. In the unlikely event that the group size is not reached, we will inform you at least 2 days before the tour date. If bookings are less than 19 pax, the tour may be operated on a mini-bus.
